Subject: Marquette Grill Holdings - Quote Request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Marquette Grill Holdings! I've reviewed the information and we're happy to work on this one.

Before I can provide a quote, I have a few questions:

- Can you confirm the construction type and year built for the location?
- What are the building's protection class and distance to the nearest fire hydrant?
- Does the insured have any cooking operations? If so, what type of suppression system is in place?
- Are there any planned renovations or equipment upgrades?

Once I have these details, I'll be able to put together competitive terms for the 12/19/26 effective date.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
